City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
APRIL 11, 2024 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce Administrative Changes to the Agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
PRESENTATION:
A.
Blue Carbon in Climate Action Planning - Angela Kemsley, Conservation Director, WILDCOAST
6.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
A.
Approval of March 14, 2024 Meeting Minutes
Item 6A_Draft Meeting Minutes 03-14-2024
7.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
A.
Green Building Incentive Program History and Proposed Revisions. Nicholas Ryan, Sustainability Intern.
8.
ACTION ITEMS
A.
April update of progress on the FY 22-23/23-24 Work Plan and review of Commission Calendar. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Review and Approve April 2024 Work Plan Update.
2.
Review Commission Calendar
Item 8A Agenda Report Work Plan Update
Item 8A Attachment 1 Work Plan Update - April 2024
Item 8A Attachment 2 - Commission Calendar
B.
Establishment of a commission subcommittee for the development of the Fiscal Year 2025 and Fiscal Year 2026 Work Plan. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Select a Commission Subcommittee to develop a draft FY25-FY26 Environmental Commission Workplan.
Item 8B Agenda Report - Work Plan Subcommittee
Item 8B Attachment 1 - FY23-FY24 Work Plan
9.
COMMISSIONER INITIATED ACTION AGENDA ITEMS
A.
None.
10.
UPDATES ON ITEMS OF INTEREST TO COMMISSION/ANNOUNCEMENTS BY COMMISSION MEMBERS/STAFF
11.
FUTURE COMMISSIONER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Discussion of possible future commissioner-initiated agenda items, including informational items, presentations, or action items, if any.
12.
ADJOURNMENT - The next Environmental Commission meeting is scheduled for May 9, 2024.
